_SHOW_TOOL_ACTIVITY: default for mirroring 🔧 tool steps, off because one line per tool call buries the prose response on a long session. /tools on|off in a topic (add 'all' for the whole chat) overrides it at runtime and persists in toolprefs.json
_CHILD_MCP_SERVERS: MCP servers a spawned child may load. Omit to inherit your full surface. [] pins the child to none, which is the cheapest and the only fully deterministic setting: the tools array leads the cached prompt prefix, so servers connecting mid-run invalidate the whole prefix and re-cache the conversation at 1h TTL (2x base input). Naming a subset is cheaper than inheriting everything but a slow server in that subset can still shift the array. Names resolve against mcpServers in MCP_CONFIG_PATH.
_MCP_CONFIG_PATH: where CHILD_MCP_SERVERS names are resolved from. Defaults to ~/.claude.json
_PRUNE_AFTER_HOURS: idle window before a topic is pruned. The older PRUNE_AFTER_DAYS spelling is still honored if present.
_TOPIC_OPENER: first message posted into a new topic: off | minimal (one line) | full (paragraph + where-it-left-off seed)
_APPEARANCE: boot-time group + bot appearance; carries only what should differ from the live objects. Unset fields are left untouched. Photo is only set when the group has NONE (representative per-group icons you set by hand are never overwritten; add force_photo:true on a chat to override). Photo paths are relative to the install dir.

APPEARANCE.bot_about: Bridges the Claude Code sessions running on my computer, over Telegram topics.
APPEARANCE.bot_description: Private, local-first gateway for the Claude Code sessions running on my computer. Every active session gets its own topic and mirrors live; reply in a topic to steer it, or /new to start a fresh one. Allowlisted users only.

-1001654782309.title: Claude Code
-1001654782309.description: Live mirror of Claude Code sessions on my computer. Reply in a topic to steer a session; /new for a fresh one. Private, allowlisted.

_TITLE_MODE: first-message (free) | session-name | generated — 'generated' spawns a Claude turn per topic-creation attempt, ~25k tokens each
_RENAME_AFTER_TURNS: with TITLE_MODE=generated, rename the topic once after this many mirrored desk prompts so its name reflects the work, not the opening message. 0 disables. /rename works regardless.
_RESTART_STALE_TURN_SECONDS: a queued restart.flag waits for injected turns to finish, but stops waiting on one that has produced no output for this long. The window must clear the longest silent stretch a healthy turn can have, which is one long tool call. Default 600.
_otlp: optional analytics: ship usage & reliability metrics to Grafana Cloud via OTLP. endpoint + instance/token from your Grafana Cloud OTLP page; auth = base64('<instanceID>:<token>'). enabled:false (or omit the block) runs the gateway unchanged and sends nothing over the network, while /stats still works from the local mirror. 'instance' is a friendly per-machine label that becomes the Prometheus 'instance' label on every series (defaults to this machine's hostname); set a distinct value per machine when several gateways report to the same Grafana stack.
